title: EEG: Attended Speaker Paradigm (Own Name in Ignored Stream)
description: EEG recordings from 25 participants performing a two-competing-speaker selective attention task, in which they attended to either the left or right audio book. The participant's own name was embedded 10 times per block in the to-be-ignored stream, allowing study of attention capture and neural tracking of attended and ignored speech. Blocks alternated between an omnidirectional condition (equal loudness) and a beamforming condition (attended stream louder).
methods_description: Each participant completed five 10-minute audio book blocks. The first block was always omnidirectional, and the remaining four alternated between omnidirectional and beamforming conditions, with the starting condition counterbalanced across participants. The participant's own name was presented 10 times per block within the ignored audio book.
